array.string: set -eu LMS="$HOME/.lmstudio/bin/lms" CURL="/usr/bin/curl" "$LMS" daemon up "$LMS" server start --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 1234 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true attempt=0 while [ "$attempt" -lt 12 ]; do if "$CURL" --fail --silent --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/models >/dev/null 2>&1; then while "$CURL" --fail --silent --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/models >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 30 done exit 1 fi attempt=$((attempt + 1)) sleep 5 done exit 1
